Lanteris Space LLC is seeking an entry-level engineer to design and implement software models for spacecraft simulators used by internal and external customers. The role supports spacecraft simulation development through testing, deployment, technical collaboration, and customer-facing design reviews.
Aerospace
Big Data
Transportation
Analytics
Space Travel
Growth Opportunities
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Design and implement models of spacecraft components and/or subsystems for all-software spacecraft simulators
Learn and apply spacecraft hardware specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical documentation to develop accurate software models
Adhere to current satellite and software industry best practices
Deploy code through existing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
Collaborate with team members to find solutions to design and evaluate technical trade-offs
Communicate cross-functionally with software and systems engineers to ensure a coherent system design
Write and perform unit, integration, and system-level tests on software applications
Participate in customer-facing design reviews and other technical discussions

Familiarity with software compilers and other software development tools
Developing software in C++ or Python
Debugging and troubleshooting software systems
Software development best practices

Preferred
Strong applied mathematics skills, including numerical methods, linear algebra, differential equations, and/or computational physics
Experience implementing mathematical algorithms in software (coursework projects, research, or professional work)
Academic projects involving simulation, modeling, or real-time systems
Relevant internship or co-op experience in software development, aerospace, or simulation
Coursework or project experience with object-oriented programming and software design patterns
Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking concepts
Exposure to Agile methodologies or modern software development practices
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to learn quickly and multi-task in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment
Passion to work on space applications
Interest in spacecraft systems, operations, design, or testing
Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Benefits
Mentorship from experienced engineers in spacecraft simulation and systems engineering
Hands-on experience with real spacecraft hardware and flight software
Opportunity to work on projects that directly support space missions
Professional development and growth opportunities in the aerospace industry
